calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task conditions the key obligation on 'the ball is out of the way of the door' (blocker_moved), not on door_open, and it never states any rule about door_open at all. The candidate's Response(door_open, blocker_moved) is an added requirement no sentence supports (the environment already makes door_open impossible before blocker_moved, so it adds nothing the task asked for, while inventing an obligation to (re)move the ball after opening the door), and Response(door_open, has_door_key) attaches the 'carry the key' duty to the wrong event. Replace both with a single hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key): every time the ball is out of the way and the key is not being carried, the key must be picked up later. That rule-only task needs no goal clause, so an empty FINAL_STATES is fine.
